bearer_note: slipped onto his finger by itself, in the dark
'why shouldn't I keep it?' (would not leave it; did, just)
after the fire: heavy, and cool
kept in his pocket, fingered often
put it on under compulsion; stabbed
the mithril coat felt light by comparison
put it on to escape Boromir; saw the Eye
the Witch-king rode past; the hand went to the chain on its own
offered him a garden the size of a realm; refused
carried, with the bearer, by Sam
fell into the fire with it
